empty: Nothing pending — type above to capture a task
load_failed: Could not load tasks from Taskwarrior

default_tags.description: Tags added to a captured task when the typed line names none itself. Comma separated, without the leading +.
default_tags.label: Default tags

glyph.description: The glyph shown for the Taskwarrior widget on the bar.
glyph.label: Bar glyph

saved_filters.description: Filter chips offered above the list, comma separated. Each one is a Taskwarrior filter expression such as +next or due.before:tomorrow.
saved_filters.label: Saved filters

task_binary.description: Command or absolute path of the task CLI. Defaults to task on PATH.
task_binary.label: Task binary

task_data_dir.description: Taskwarrior data directory (rc.data.location). Empty uses the directory from the task rc file.
task_data_dir.label: Task data directory

task_rc.description: Taskwarrior rc file (task rc:path). Empty uses Taskwarrior's default ~/.taskrc.
task_rc.label: Task rc file

task_missing: Taskwarrior CLI not found — install taskwarrior or set the task binary in the plugin settings
title: Taskwarrior
